requirements.evidence: All contract pieces present: migrations with named indexes `entities_slug_unique` (create_entities_table.php:17) and `entity_memberships_one_owner` on stored generated `owner_seq` (create_entity_memberships_table.php:20,24), cascade FKs, role default 'employee'; Entity with SoftDeletes, getRouteKeyName()='slug', memberships/users/owner() (Entity.php:20-51); EntityMembership role cast + owner/admin/employee scopes; UserRole::manageable(); User::membershipFor(); factories with states; both policies matching the stated rules. Small gap: EntityMembershipPolicy::assignRole (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:16-21) lets an admin assign a role on the owner's own membership, which undermines the single-owner model; nothing verified by tests.

conventions.evidence: Conventions require 'No production code without a test; everything implemented ships with a test' — no test files at all in the diff. Positives: policies in app/Policies, deliberate $fillable (Entity.php:18, EntityMembership.php:21), reversible down() in both migrations, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md updated.

security.evidence: Policies deny non-members by checking membershipFor() !== null (EntityPolicy.php:17-40); owner membership can never be deleted (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:25-27); DB enforces single owner. Minor gap: assignRole does not prevent an admin from targeting the owner's membership (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:16-21). $fillable includes entity_id/user_id/role on EntityMembership, acceptable given writes go through actions/policies.

tests.evidence: No Pest/PHPUnit tests in the diff: nothing covers the one-owner DB constraint, the unique (entity_id,user_id), slug binding, factories, or any policy allow/deny path.

simplicity.evidence: Lean models and policies; uses native generated column + unique index. Minor duplication: `in_array($membership->role, [UserRole::Owner, UserRole::Admin], true)` repeated in EntityPolicy.php:26,33 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:20,35, and update/delete in EntityPolicy are identical bodies.

readability.evidence: Clear names, small methods, typed relations with generics PHPDoc (Entity.php:25-50, User.php:173-188), sibling-style factories and migrations; no dead code.

scope.evidence: Only models, enum, policies, factories, migrations, schema doc and changelog; no routes, session, UI or translations.

issues.explanation: The change ships no tests for the migrations' constraints, models, factories or the two policies, violating the mandatory TDD convention.
assignRole allows an admin to change the role of the owner's membership, so an admin could demote the owner; the target's role is not checked.
update() and delete() duplicate the same owner/admin check that is also repeated in EntityMembershipPolicy; a small helper would avoid four copies.

review.summary: The change implements the entity/membership schema (including the portable single-owner generated column and named unique indexes), the models, enum, factories, both policies and updates the schema doc and changelog, all within scope and readable. However it ships no tests at all, which violates the project's mandatory test-first convention, and assignRole does not protect the owner's membership; it needs tests before it can be merged.
